text: how big is a floor vs a tile in hmsc-int tooling
resolution: Answered the scale question by consulting the game oracle first, then verifying hmsc-int source constants. Confirmed that a painted/world tile is 1m x 1m, a build floor plate is a 3m x 3m semantic piece with 0.2m thickness, and an iso/build floor level is one 3m storey. No files changed.
